item.title: Veer 1.0.4
item.description:
Veer 1.0.4 测试版 · Test build

  • 新的 Liquid Glass 工具栏：控件按用途分组，概览顶部可以直接切换出站模式，启动和停止有动画提示。 / A new Liquid Glass toolbar: controls grouped by purpose, outbound mode on the overview's toolbar, and an animation as the core starts and stops.
  • 新增“工具”页，DNS 移到这里；配置移到“代理”页顶部，可以快速切换，工具栏的 + 用来导入。 / A new Tools page, which now holds DNS. Profiles move to the top of Proxies for quick switching, with + in the toolbar to import.
  • 可以在设置里更新 Mihomo 内核。 / Update the Mihomo core from Settings.
  • 分流改动可以从“编辑”菜单撤销，清空历史也能撤销。 / Undo routing changes from the Edit menu, and undo clearing history.
  • 节点地图按国家着色，策略组可以全部收起。 / The node map shades countries, and all groups can collapse at once.
  • TUN 需要安装组件时会先弹窗说明；出口检测有进行中的动画，超时后才显示无法检测。 / An alert explains the TUN helper before it installs. Exit detection shows progress, and reports failure only after a timeout.
  • 修复带搜索框的页面之间切换时崩溃、Agent 面板崩溃；停止再启动时保留系统代理；窄窗口布局和浅色、深色下的文字对比度也有改善。 / Fixes crashes when switching between pages with a search field and in the Agent panel. The system proxy now stays on across stop and start, and narrow layouts and text contrast in light and dark are better.
